To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) APC wires have a significantly higher Sn content in their Nb3Sn layers than standard wires, and this high Sn content is the main contributor to their high upper critical field.
we have demonstrated achievement of record nonCu critical current density (JC,non-Cu ) in ternary, multi filamentary Nb3Sn wires with artificial pinning centres (APC).
we have achieved a non-copper critical current density (non-Cu Jc) of 1,100 A/mm2 at 21 T and 4.2K in ternary multifilamentary superconductors with artificially introduced pinning centers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of APC wires, which are expected to be a key technology for the FCC and future accelerators.
the development and understanding of the artificial pinning center (APC) concept for Nb3Sn conductive wire.
the fabrication of Nb3Sn superconductor wires with artificial pinning center (APC).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the APC wire development has been very successful and that we have made great strides towards the goal of achieving FCC-specification Jc,nonCU in APC wires.
we have demonstrated the achievement of record non-copper critical current density in ternary, multistrand Nb3Sn conductor by the introduction of Artificial Pinning Centers.
APC Nb3Sn conductive wires with high Bc2 and Jc have been demonstrated and the Jc, non-Cu-B of APC Nb3 Sn conductors has achieved the FCC specification.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated that APC wires have great promise as a high-performance Nb3Sn conductor for future applications.
APC wires are now at the same level as the state-of-the-art wires in terms of non-Cu Jc, but have a higher Bc2.
the Jc, non-Cu-B of APC wires is approaching the level needed for the FCC, but the Sn/Nb ratio needs to be further increased for APC conductors to become practical.
The main takeaway from our work is that
APC wires have great potential for high field applications.
the APC wires are a viable option for the development of Nb3Sn conductores for high field magnets.
the introduction of APCs is a viable route to achieve the Jc, non-Cu-B specification at 21T.
